title: Let support look up a customer by email
description: Support staff need to find a customer from the email address they give over the phone. Adds GET /api/admin/users?email= for admins, with the customer and their number of orders. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: Signup and login store and match emails trimmed and lowercased, but the lookup uses the email exactly as typed, so `Ada@Example.com` or a trailing space finds no customer; normalise it the same way first.
